spans.s:
Yantṛ in the Rigveda and in the Sūtras denotes a ‘driver’ of horses or ‘charioteer.’
Foot notes i. 162, 19; x. 22, 5.
Kātyāyana śrauta sūtra, xv. 6, 29, etc.

Yāna denotes ‘vehicle’ in the Rigveda and later.
Foot notes iv. 43, 6.
Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, v. 5, 3, 7; Ṣaḍviṃśa brāhmaṇa, vi. 3, 10; Chāndogya upaniṣad, viii. 12, 3, etc.
